verdict.rationale: Composio documents a large catalog of 1000+ apps (1,500+ toolkits per llms.txt). Agents can search it by task through COMPOSIO_SEARCH_TOOLS without knowing tool slugs, and the CLI lets a person at the terminal inspect schemas. However, the documented discovery mostly happens at runtime by the agent, inside an already-created session or connected plugin, rather than as a developer-facing browse step before wiring anything in. The catalog is also of Composio toolkits, not of third-party MCP servers. Missing for 10: a documented developer-facing catalog browse/search UI or API for exploring tools by capability before integration, any registry of external MCP servers, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the discovery experience.
